sectors.note:
**TL;DR:** Financials achieve a rare "all-green" breadth status despite an unstable rank, while Technology and Industrials maintain their dominant momentum leads as Communication Services fades.

Technology (0.833 momentum, YTD rank 1) and Industrials (0.783 momentum, YTD rank 3) continue to anchor the market's leadership, with Industrials demonstrating sustained strength across the 1-, 3-, and 6-month horizons. Financials have also carved out a leadership spot, emerging as the only sector with "all-green" breadth across all timeframes, gaining 1 spot to rank 8th with a momentum score of 0.633. 

The rest of the market remains highly static, with eight of the eleven sectors showing no rank changes over the last five sessions. Communication Services is the notable exception, experiencing the sharpest decline by dropping 2 spots to rank 10 with a weak momentum score of 0.250. Consumer Cyclical remains anchored at the bottom of the market at rank 11, carrying a momentum score of just 0.133.

## Strength
* **Financials Breadth:** Financials (momentum 0.633, rank 8) is the sole sector out of 11 to achieve "all-green" status, posting positive performance across the week, month, quarter, half-year, and YTD.
* **Sustained Industrials:** Industrials (momentum 0.783, rank 3) continues to show persistent strength, maintaining a top-3 rank across the 1-, 3-, and 6-month periods.
* **Technology Leadership:** Technology remains the absolute momentum leader at 0.833, comfortably holding its YTD rank of 1.

## Movers & Momentum
* **Marginal Gainers:** Financials and Healthcare were the only sectors to improve their standings over the last five sessions, each gaining +1 spot to reach rank 8 (momentum 0.633) and rank 9 (momentum 0.500) respectively.
* **Communication Services Slump:** Communication Services fell furthest over the last five sessions, dropping -2 spots to rank 10 with a momentum score of 0.250.
* **Consumer Cyclical Drag:** Consumer Cyclical continues to lag the entire market, locked at rank 11 with a momentum score of 0.133.

## Divergences
* **Fragile Financials:** Despite its clean sweep of positive performance across all timeframes, the "all-green" signal for Financials is fragile, flagged by a low agreement score of 0.40.
* **Energy Momentum Decoupling:** Energy maintains a highly favorable YTD rank of 2, yet its momentum score has deteriorated to 0.467, placing it among the market's momentum laggards.

industries.note:
**TL;DR:** Heavy industrials and technology hardware maintain dominant market leadership, while a sharp rotation is underway as precious metals plunge and early-stage defensive groups emerge.

Industrial machinery, electrical components, and hardware continue to anchor the market's core strength. Electrical Equipment & Parts (momentum 0.941) and Electronics & Computer Distribution (momentum 0.939) lead a resilient cohort of 25 "all-green" industries showing positive performance across all timeframes. This strength is supported by steady momentum in Computer Hardware (momentum 0.915) and Farm & Heavy Construction Machinery (momentum 0.938). 

In contrast, a sharp rotation is hitting the commodities space. Precious metals and mining groups are fading rapidly, highlighted by Silver dropping 30 spots to rank 67 and Gold falling 21 spots to rank 109. Capital is rotating into selective laggards, with Biotechnology surging 21 spots to rank 64 (momentum 0.74) and Banks - Diversified climbing 12 spots to rank 50 (momentum 0.80).

## Strength
* **Broad-Based Strength:** 25 of 144 industry groups maintain "all-green" status, showing positive performance across weekly, monthly, quarterly, half-year, and YTD horizons.
* **Industrial & Tech Leaders:** Electrical Equipment & Parts (momentum 0.941), Electronics & Computer Distribution (0.939), and Farm & Heavy Construction Machinery (0.938) anchor the top of the YTD momentum rankings.
* **Sustained Performers:** Metal Fabrication, Computer Hardware, and REIT - Hotel & Motel continue to show sustained multi-month strength, remaining in the top 36 across 1-, 3-, and 6-month rankings.

## Movers & Momentum
* **Top Gainers:** Biotechnology led weekly gains, climbing 21 spots to rank 64 (momentum 0.74), followed by Specialty Industrial Machinery (+13 spots to rank 28; momentum 0.81) and Banks - Diversified (+12 spots to rank 50; momentum 0.80).
* **Sharpest Declines:** Coking Coal fell 31 spots to rank 112 (momentum 0.36), while Silver plummeted 30 spots to rank 67 (momentum 0.41), and Grocery Stores dropped 24 spots to rank 111 (momentum 0.11).
* **Momentum Laggards:** Pharmaceutical Retailers (momentum 0.077, rank 144) and Software - Application (momentum 0.090, rank 141) remain anchored at the bottom of the market.

## Divergences
* **Fading Commodities & Cyclicals:** Several metal and transport groups are showing early signs of fatigue; Steel (momentum 0.68) fell 8 spots, and Copper (momentum 0.69) dropped 3 spots over the last 5 sessions.
* **Emerging Low-Momentum Groups:** Beverages - Wineries & Distilleries (+14 spots, rank 98) and Utilities - Independent Power Producers (+13 spots, rank 121) are jumping in rank despite still-subdued momentum (0.44 and 0.41, respectively).
* **Financial & Service Rotation:** Credit Services (+10 spots, momentum 0.43) and Education & Training Services (+10 spots, momentum 0.39) are turning the corner with positive rank jumps from low momentum baselines.
